Fresh advise of add-router-admitted-ula after a send-back. Author family is Grok. You are astra-arch-review. High blast: protocol (Babel in/out filters). Do not edit reviews/2026-11-01-advise.md or reviews/2026-11-01-blind-take.md. Write a new file.

Why (from proposal.md, not design.md): Babel on br-mesh and on mjolnir0 already exports this house's router /128 and allows that house /48 at prefix length 128. An admitted foreign house is still inside the fc00::/7 deny, so its host routes never cross either Babel. A covering prefix would make the foreign /48 on-link. The foreign prefix has to be the same kind of host allow, and nothing else.

The proposal now also says: the publisher guarantees admitted foreign house /48s and replaces the file when the house changes. The reader counts only an fd00::/8 /48, skips ula_prefix() (fd53:6213:4797::/48 for this build) and the guild-file house /48 even when the /128 is unusable, and does not denylist other stock prefixes. A missing file clears the list. An unreadable file keeps the last good read. A failed Babel restart stays pending and is retried on the next pass.
